title: Preview: the first errand
note: Mechanics preview on an invented railway, not history. Two and a half days in Corvenia: one short commission (Corlaine, then Port-Ancel), the diary, a booking, the slack before a train, and a change across Aubrevaux whose odds the planner shows.

values.name: starting cash
values.rationale: Enough for two journeys and a night; little more.

values.name: letter of credit
values.rationale: £20 drawable at the Aubrevaux and Corlaine correspondents.

values.name: stage windows
values.rationale: The first fits the afternoon trains; the second needs either the tight morning change across Aubrevaux or a night in Aubrevaux.
